modifications: Standalone Cargo manifest with embedded feature and pinned libc dependency.
Embedded builds suppress upstream logs; application reports redacted operation errors.
Embedded builds cap peers at 32, retained search responses at 50 and retained search files at 1000.
Embedded decompression ceilings: 8 MiB ordinary payloads; 16 MiB listings.
Embedded peer frame and receive-buffer ceilings: 8 MiB; length arithmetic checked on 32-bit targets.
Embedded search parser bounds usernames, filenames, file counts and attributes before retention; aggregate cap enforced exactly.
Download worker stop/counter API enables JNI to await teardown before file cleanup.
Open-file limit comparison normalized for Android 32-bit rlim_t.
Embedded pending peer write backlog capped at 1 MiB.
